name: Antigravity CLI
description: Launch the Google Antigravity CLI in Pragma with live status, approvals, questions, sub-agents, usage limits, and session naming.
longDescription: Launch the Google Antigravity CLI (agy) from the Pragma launcher with live status, command approvals, questions, sub-agent activity, quota usage limits, and session naming. The integration installs as a native Antigravity plugin and reports into Pragma's tab and sidebar, so Antigravity work in one worktree never hides progress in another.
